create_LayerNorm_module: create a LayerNorm module with hidden size, bias, and optional gated activation
create_RMSNorm_module: create an RMSNorm module with hidden size, optional group norm, and swish activation
build_rms_norm_gated: build a fused RMS norm with gated activation using Triton kernels on GPU
run_layernorm_fn: run a layernorm function with optional z gating, group size, and norm-before-gate ordering
test_rms_norm_ref: test the reference RMS norm implementation with bias, group size, and activation options
